business_overview: HDFC AMC (NSE/BSE: HDFCAMC) manages mutual fund schemes across equity, debt and hybrid categories, and is majority-owned (52.4%) by HDFC Bank. It is one of India's largest asset managers by AUM, benefiting from India's structural shift from physical savings (gold, real estate) to financial assets (mutual funds, SIPs) and from the HDFC brand/distribution network.
